memories.text: AnyCompany SOHO Studio is a 2-person marketing and brand consultancy. Darla Emiliano is the founder; Diego Ramírez is her first hire (part-time associate marketer). They serve 5 retainer clients (Bloom & Vine Florals $1,800/mo, Foundry Coffee Roasters $2,000/mo, Cedar & Co. Law $2,200/mo, Rivera Family Dental $2,000/mo, Northside Yoga $1,500/mo), have 1 project in delivery (Grid Street Bikes, $4,200 project fee), and 2 prospects (Harbor Point B&B, Lumen Pediatrics). Retainer revenue is about $9,500/mo; with active project work a typical month runs roughly $12,000-$14,000.

The studio uses two per-project subcontractors who are NOT on the Quick Plus account: Marcus Lindqvist (design) and Jordan (copywriter). Marcus recently sent a rate increase — brand projects from $2,000 to $2,400, hourly from $85 to $95. He included volume commitment options.

Each client has a distinct brand voice, and Darla uses the Client Voice Brief agent to capture it before drafting client-facing content. Bloom & Vine is warm, personal, and floral; Foundry Coffee is casual and community-driven; Cedar & Co. is professional and authoritative; Rivera Dental is friendly and approachable; Grid Street Bikes is bold and urban.

Darla adapts her invoice-reminder tone by client relationship: warm and appreciative for long-term retainer clients, firmer for project deposits where work is already underway. Her reminders reference the invoice number, amount, and days overdue.

Diego has access to the AnyCompany SOHO Client Work Space and the Client Voice Brief agent. Darla's practice is to share new reusable helpers with him so he can ramp faster. He's starting with Foundry Coffee and Bloom & Vine work.

This is a demo workspace. The people, companies, and the mail and messaging entries in the knowledge graph and activity feed are fictitious sample data and do not correspond to any real mail or messaging account.
